case_name: Durgesh Kumari Verma D/O Shri Suresh vs The State Of Rajasthan

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Durgesh Kumari Verma, Aged About 33 Years, R/o Village Matunda, Tehsil And District Bundi (Raj.)
parties.respondent_defendant: The State Of Rajasthan, Through Principle Secretary, Panchayati Raj Department, Government Of Rajasthan, Government Secretariat, Jaipur and Zila Parishad, Kota Through Its Chief Executive Officer, Kota (Raj.)

facts_of_case: Petitioner challenging the action of respondents whereby the petitioner has been denied appointment on the post of Lower Division Clerk in the category of female divorcee SC pursuant to advertisement dated 14-2-2013.

legal_principles.held: TODO — what court actually said (2-4 sentences)

outcome.final_order: Petitioner's candidature was rejected due to lack of decree of divorce, but court held that agreement of divorce is not sufficient and petitioner needs a decree of divorce to be considered in female divorcee category.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for appointment denial
